4a1de8df-6f03-5a3d-bbfa-7c1144d2ec5c.content: Do not exceed two primary HCI contributions.

b5b6a901-9047-5482-a0e1-d29e5f7171e8.content: Name each design or empirical contribution and present it in a single sentence.

e89de514-48a5-5e9b-96ca-f194c0ed79ab.content: In studies recruiting community participants, emphasize the time burden associated with participation.

f7025cbb-4005-53c6-9031-e33f04a86b92.content: In studies recruiting community participants, emphasize the travel burden associated with participation.

a42891a1-b674-5747-a77c-43699b0b9723.content: HCI reviewers find it difficult to identify primary contributions when named design or empirical contributions exceed two.

9d7169d5-058f-5f7c-b1ac-30cabd8ba02e.content: Emphasize the core design decisions that formative evaluation will change rather than a polished product demonstration.

f8931b4e-9656-548d-84a1-f2f2c3eb47b1.content: Emphasize design principles transferable to other similar interactions as the primary contribution, rather than the performance of a specific prototype.

9bf9e735-7598-5977-abe2-87b2c9c38a24.content: Formative evaluation creates grounds for modification in subsequent iterations rather than definitively determining the superiority of design alternatives.
